async def act(page):
    # Fill the textbox to select members with 'Koushik'
    textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Select members to invite")
    await textbox.fill("Koushik")
    # Wait for the autocomplete dropdown to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Select the option 'Koushik Dutta @koush' from the dropdown
    option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Koushik Dutta @koush")
    await option.click()
    # Wait briefly for the button to become enabled
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the 'Add to project' button to invite Koushik
    add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add to project")
    await add_button.click()
